candidates.event: US eases some tariffs on Canadian goods from 30 October

facts.claim: From 30 October tariffs will be eased on plywood, some paper products, certain machinery and refrigeration equipment, per the White House
facts.quote: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on products including "plywood sheets, some paper products, certain machinery and refrigeration equipment", the White House said on Friday.

facts.claim: Tariffs will be introduced on other items such as carpets and waste products
facts.quote: they would be introduced on other items such as carpets and "waste products".

facts.claim: The US imposed a 50% levy on $20bn of Canadian goods after talks collapsed in August
facts.quote: The US imposed a 50% levy on $20bn (£15bn) worth of Canadian goods after trade talks between the two countries collapsed in August.

candidates.notes: Announced by the White House (relayed by BBC); of limited relevance to an Israeli audience, possibly borderline. Also reported by The Guardian (s210) without confirmed date in the index.
